name: No natural healing
author: celophi
description: Hit points only come back from items, techniques, pets and leaving a dungeon.

options.name: After a game over
options.description: What Continue does when the party falls.

choices.name: Back to the entrance
choices.description: Continue takes you back to where you came in from the world map, with everything since then undone and your hit points full.

choices.name: No Continue
choices.description: There's no Continue. Go back to the title screen and load your last save.

choices.name: Retry without healing
choices.description: Continue tries the screen again with the hit points you came into it with.
